preconditions.description: The input is a single string s with length between 5 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The first line of stdout is the integer k, the count of distinct valid suffixes, followed by k lines containing the suffixes.
The remaining lines in stdout are the distinct valid suffixes sorted in lexicographical order.

postconditions.expression: all(2 <= len(sub) <= 3 for sub in sorted_suffixes)
postconditions.description: Every suffix in the output has a length of either 2 or 3.
All suffixes in the output are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(any(valid_suffix_partition(s, sub) for sub in sorted_suffixes) or len(sorted_suffixes) == 0)
postconditions.description: Every suffix listed is valid: there exists a partition of the string s into a root (length > 4) and a sequence of suffixes (length 2 or 3) where no two adjacent suffixes are identical, and the suffix appears in that sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(not valid_suffix_partition(s, sub) for sub in all_possible_suffixes if sub not in sorted_suffixes)
postconditions.description: The set of output suffixes is complete: no other string of length 2 or 3 that could validly appear as a suffix in a valid partition is missing.
